description: Current units, zero codes and constants of the decoded fields: the one place a unit correction is made first. tests/test_units_ledger.py checks ars510/ (objects, interface, constants), the profile files and docs/03 against it, and fails when a retired value comes back. Values are the current readings of docs/03, 05 and 06, with their confidence.

LONG_VEL_GROUND.conf: nominal; the list reads relative motion low (docs/06)

ACCEL_LIKE.conf: field likely; scale approximate (ego stopped, depends on drive set and estimator)

range_unc_code.doc_text: 0.24 m per count below 40 m, 0.23 overall

ego.note: the owner car's value; on the two other cars the object-list vRel then carries 0.07 % / 0.4 % of ego speed (0.12 m/s at 30 m/s on car C)

radar_cycle_s.note: long-run record period in log time, 0x80 header clock 603 x 100 us, 0x85 prefix clock 60,280 x 1 us per record, both cars; the median arrival interval reads 59.9 ms because arrivals jitter

retired.why: empirical 0.149 m/s per code with unscaled 0xB4: replaced by 0.15 and 0xB4 / 0.9865 (2.6.1)
ACC target speed at 0.1 m/s per code: the unit is 0.125 (SCR-463)
ACC target relative acceleration at 0.1 m/s^2 per code: the unit is 0.125
256|8 at 0.0062 m/s^2 per count was the frame jitter, not the code's unit (0.06-0.07 per count within 20 m)
84|10: zero 510.3, about 0.075 m/s^2 per code with ego stopped
